Uniswap is a decentralized exchange that runs on the Ethereum public blockchain. Uniswap uses an automated market maker design that prices trades with liquidity pools rather than order books. Uniswap allows liquidity providers to earn trading fees from the pools they fund. Uniswap is permissionless, so anyone can create a pool for a new token pair. Uniswap is governed through its UNI governance token.

Bancor is a decentralized exchange protocol that runs on the Ethereum public blockchain. Bancor uses an automated market maker design built on smart contracts. Bancor uses its BNT token as a connector token between pairs of other tokens. Bancor offers impermanent loss protection to liquidity providers in its later protocol version.

Aave is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol that runs on public blockchains. Aave requires borrowers to provide collateral that exceeds the value of their loans. Aave supports both variable and stable borrowing interest rates. Aave offers flash loans that must be borrowed and repaid within a single blockchain transaction. Aave issues aTokens to depositors as receipts for their deposited assets. Aave is governed through its AAVE governance token.

Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) System is the collateralized stablecoin system of the Maker Protocol on the Ethereum public blockchain. Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) System issues the DAI stablecoin against collateral locked in smart contract vaults. Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) System accepts several different collateral asset types. Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) System requires overcollateralized debt positions. Multi-Collateral Dai (MCD) System is governed through its MKR governance token.

Compound is an algorithmic money market protocol that runs on the Ethereum public blockchain. Compound sets its interest rates algorithmically based on the supply and demand for each asset. Compound issues cTokens to suppliers as receipts that accrue interest over time. Compound requires borrowers to hold overcollateralized positions. Compound allows third-party liquidators to repay unhealthy loans in exchange for a discount on collateral. Compound distributes its COMP governance token to users of the protocol.
